name: Margaret
source:
Role: Almoner 
Quiet, calm, and very talented. At first I was at a loss as to how she and Katherine could be such close friends, but they both have a wicked sense of humor. [Spoiler]They're too clever by half... Margaret knows all of the passageways around the abbey. She also showed me a terrible etching deep within the walls. She and Catherine seem to have been very close.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
